notes.title: Latest Update on Myth of Empires: Profession Changes, Crop Expertise, and More!
notes.notes:
We are excited to bring you the latest news on the Persia DLC: [h3]The DLC has been officially titled Xizhou Civilization DLC.[/h3] Next week, we will reveal the release date and other important details. Stay tuned!

After the previous nine developer logs, you’re likely already familiar with the content of the Xizhou Civilization DLC. But the excitement doesn’t stop there. Along with the release of the Xizhou Civilization DLC, Myth of Empires will also introduce a series of new features and gameplay elements, such as profession changes, crop expertise, Martial Scripture Scrolls, construction bureau buildings, and zipline buildings. These additions will bring an even richer and more diverse gaming experience.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e2fb9c00a1829f482878c26114d327424557ea85.jpg[/img]

[h2]Next, let’s get an exclusive sneak peek at the new content coming with this developer log:[/h2]

[h3]1.	Profession Change[/h3]
Five new professions will be available: Imperial Guard, Tiger Step, Berseker Battalion, Silver Wing Guard, and Martial Archery Expert.
a.	Once the player's character reaches level 40 and a specific skill proficiency of 600, they can learn a new profession. Additionally, after meeting the required conditions, players can switch to and learn other professions in the profession change interface.
b.	Professions can level up: While in an active state, using the corresponding weapon and equipment for a profession, players can earn experience points by defeating enemies.
c.	Each profession skill has specific weapon and equipment requirements, and only by using the corresponding weapon for that profession can players unleash profession skills and trigger profession talents.
d.	The number of equip-able profession skills and talents is influenced by the profession level. Each profession can equip up to 2 profession skills and 4 profession talents at the same time.

[h3]2.	Crops Expertise[/h3]
A brand-new Crop Expertise system is planned to be introduced for six crop types: Wheat, Barley, Flax, Notoginseng, Rice, and Soybean.
a.	When harvesting these six types of crops, there is a chance to obtain a corresponding Mother Plant. Additionally, harvesting these crops will also increase the corresponding Expertise Level for each crop.
b.	Expertise Level affects: the total fertilizer discount value for dropping mother plants, the number of uses, and the entry skills (which vary in quality).
c.	Mother plants have entry skills, but there are differences between them. By deploying the mother plant for sowing (this also applies when warriors plant crops), you can harvest crops that have the effect of the mother plant’s skills (excluding low-quality crops).
d.	Mother plants can be cultivated: By breeding two different mother plants, you can create a new mother plant with different levels, entry skills, and weaknesses.

[h3]3.	Martial Scripture Scrolls[/h3]
There are two types: Common Secret Scroll and Ancient Secret Scroll. The basic functions are described as follows:
a.	Modification: For scrolls that have already been obtained, you can consume specific materials to randomly grant the scroll new attributes. Each modification will increase the modification proficiency, and reaching a certain proficiency level will upgrade the modification level.
b.	Blessing: By consuming a scroll, its attributes can be attached to equipment. Additionally, depending on the modification level, when using equipment that has been blessed, the character will gain extra bonuses, in addition to the attributes granted by the scroll.
c.	Consume: Using equipment that has been blessed with an Ancient Scroll, you can alter its smithing attributes and maximum durability through the consume process.
d.	Reshape: Using equipment that has been blessed with an Ancient Scroll, you can change its level, appearance, and attack method through the Reshape process.

[h3]4.	Construction Bureau Building[/h3]
The player’s character can act as a supervisor or hire a supervisor. By utilizing the construction bureau buildings, warriors can take over certain tasks for the player, including gathering, transporting, crafting, farming, harvesting, recruiting and training, fishing, and more.  

[h3]5.	Zipline Buildings[/h3]
This includes two building components: the Slide Pole and the Zip Line Pole. By consuming iron chains, the two poles can be connected, allowing players to slide along the rope between the zipline poles using the Slide Pole. With this structure, players will be able to quickly reach their destination.

[h3]6.	Horse Grooming[/h3]
In the stable, players can customize the appearance of their horses. This feature was introduced in the previous developer log, so interested players can refer back to it.

Next week, we will officially announce the release date for the Xizhou Civilization DLC. We also welcome you to continue following Myth of Empires official social media accounts or join our community to participate in discussions.

notes.title: Myth of Empires Modkit Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Calling all creative minds!

The Myth of Empires Modkit is now available for download. Players who want to make their own creations for Myth of Empires can download the modkit here: [url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/myth-of-empires-mod-kit]https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/myth-of-empires-mod-kit[/url]

It has always been our dream to put this powerful tool in the hands of players so that they can bring to life the Myth of Empires they envision. We will also be holding events in the future to celebrate the Myth of Empires modding communities greatest creations. Please note that this modkit is a work in progress, and will be updated periodically.

Here are some basic tutorials for using this modkit:
[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/140FpC2U_mKMeTjBSvWB8Mky-nKNGqhZZ?usp=sharing]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/140FpC2U_mKMeTjBSvWB8Mky-nKNGqhZZ?usp=sharing[/url]

If you run into any issues while using the modkit or have feedback/suggestions that you’d like to provide, you can do so on our official Discord here: [url=https://discord.com/channels/786062570095116293/1173537283987742740]https://discord.com/channels/786062570095116293/1173537283987742740[/url]

Please be aware that the previous modding devkit you acquired via keys in the Epic store will be discarded and we will not update that version.

As always, thank you for supporting Myth of Empires. We look forward to seeing what you come up with!

notes.title: Myth of Empires V1.0 New Aerial Vehicles and Gameplay Changes!
notes.notes:
First of all, the Myth of Empires development team would like to wish everyone a Happy New Year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e3fb4729c8fe8b8be18ab9f841e5c8da9748d046.jpg[/img]

We recently debuted the “Raft” vehicle that will be sailing into the world of Myth of Empires in the Version 1.0 release. Today, we are going to focus on something entirely new to MoE: flight!

Let’s start with the Giant Sky Lantern. This vehicle will allow players to move through the air, and also provides some defensive and offensive capabilities. Players will be able to place small pieces of furniture and even small ballistas on the platform beneath the lantern. The Giant Sky Lantern works like a hot air balloon, with lift provided by a flame on the central platform. It can also move forward and turn with the help of a power cage. To use the Giant Sky Lantern, simply place a tamed fox or rabbit within the power cage, and make sure they are well-fed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/d52b33b432a41afd1290361a73c921e5cdd5b690.jpg[/img]

The Giant Sky Lantern, along with the recently-announced Raft, are but two of the new vehicles offered in Version 1.0 that players will have at their disposal to traverse the ever-expanding world of Myth of Empires. Later, larger upgraded vehicles will be added to meet more comprehensive construction needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/a84a22c0380623b0be0ddfba3468fd2226195646.jpg[/img]

Next up, we have the Kite Launcher. True to its name, it is a large ballista that launches kites. These kites are different from the gliders we showed off in the Version 1.0 trailer. While gliders allow players to control their flight, these kites cannot change direction. Yet they also have their advantages. For instance, it is much easier to take flight using a kite launcher as opposed to a glider. Their flight distance can also be increased by launching them from greater heights. Kites can be equipped with a small number of items and then launched unmanned to achieve basic supply delivery objectives, or players can hang from them to move around the map more quickly. Players will also be able to launch arrows from the kite, as well as disengage from it mid-flight and descend to the ground using their own gliders, making them great for sneak attacks and reconnaissance.

Together, the Giant Sky Lantern, Kite Launcher, and hang glider mark a new era in Myth of Empires, one in which players will take to the skies to expand their dominance.

In addition, we’d also like to answer some of the questions that players have been asking us about Version 1.0.

1. [b]Server interoperability.[/b] Myth of Empires Version 1.0 will have two server groups:[u][b] Classic Era Servers and New Era Servers[/b][/u]. Classic Era Servers cover servers that already exist. The data on these will not be deleted. Servers with the new map will be added to this server group, and will be interoperable with the old servers. New Era Servers will feature all brand-new servers featuring the old map, as well as new servers featuring the new map, which will be interoperable with one another. Classic Era Servers and New Era Servers are not interoperable (see the figure below). These changes will all be implemented upon the Version 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/5adeb0e9f5072cf7155bcc7e72e94399b26303db.jpg[/img]

2. [b]Counties and Prefectures.[/b] After the servers are adjusted, the number of counties in a single prefecture will be expanded from the original 16.
3. [b]Proficiency.[/b] Players will be able to accumulate reserve Proficiency EXP from the game lobby.
4. [b]Guild Adjustments.[/b] Guild member limits, alliance limits, and the number of counties conquerable by a single guild have all been adjusted.
5. [b]New Ways to Collect Resources.[/b] New structures similar to the “Mining Hut” will be released to cover even more types of resources.

notes.title: Merry Christmas! Have a Sneak Peek at new Version 1.0 Content!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/28eae615bfb44cddd6e544b1b33a86e1d5feba0d.jpg[/img]

As Christmas approaches, the Myth of Empires team sends its sincere blessings to all players!

At the same time, we would also like to debut a piece of new content that you will experience in Version 1.0: the raft.

With its power cage, paddles, and rudder, the raft is one of the key means of transportation connecting the Dongzhou Islands. You can get a basic idea how it moves from all the rotating devices, gears, and transmission rods visible on the raft’s model. The raft also supports small defensive structures and furniture.

The raft requires a tamed wild boar or wolf to move. Simply place the animal in the raft’s power cage and make sure it’s properly fed, and you will be able to conquer the waters between the Dongzhou Islands. Previously, wolves and boars could only be farmed for materials, but in Version 1.0, these powerful creatures will play a much greater role. Cultivate and breed high-quality animal bloodlines to ensure that you have the best animals for the job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/a892ca4dfbfb271633149ed92ec55e03dc795832.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Myth of Empires Releases Version 1.0 Trailer, Reveals New Map!
notes.notes:
Greetings all! We have made a brand new trailer that shows off core gameplay and the new content included in the Version 1.0 release, check it out!

[previewyoutube=2C5zMjXWoZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

Myth of Empires Version 1.0 optimizes the gameplay that players came to know and love during the game’s Early Access period. It enriches it with additional content including revamped boss AI, gliders, climbing tools, an immersive planting system, and an all-new map debuted for the first time at the end of the trailer.

Myth of Empires will be bigger, better, and more immersive than ever, and this trailer gives you a first look at all of the cool stuff we've been working on. We can't wait for you to jump into the game and see it all for themselves this February.

[h2]Key features available in Myth of Empires Version 1.0[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/b10a9e5995ff199e114d16446ee4f9f9e1e69ab4.jpg[/img]

New ways to traverse the world, include soaring gliders, climbing tools that will allow players to scale towering walls, and platform saddles that can be used for combat or simple transportation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/857e2c65fd49cacf5c358dd1a9e9c9b53f0c1ede.jpg[/img]

New defensive structures and mechanical collection tools liberate players’ creativity and enable them to build ever more advanced and powerful empires.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/bc921b013fc220d0465acd854f83e0b1796c47aa.jpg[/img]

Dongzhou Island - an expansive new world featuring islets, volcanoes, seas, and ships, as well as new boss content. This map is a free addition to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273094/e14f8679eb3a7873ee1e7f60d0b30b36e62ce2bb.jpg[/img]

New ways to play the game, including hosted and solo modes. In addition, private servers have been upgraded to have the same functionality as the official servers.

Modding support as well as a robust modding tool, gives players more power over the world of Myth of Empires than ever before.

Simulated sieges and challenges on the three major battlefields (County Battles, Fortress Battles, and Prefecture Battles) that will allow PvE players to experience the game’s large-scale combat against NPCs, and provide PvP players a chance to hone their strategic abilities.

New skills to make combat even more immersive and engaging.

A new planting system allows players to grow crops wherever they like, freeing them from the tether of restricted plots.

A new horse racing mode.

New characters, weapons, structure, saddle, and armor cosmetics will be released with updates after the Version 1.0 release.
